title: Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33890v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated retrieval-augmented generation retrieves evidence from distributed corpora. However, broadcasting queries to all clients increases the retrieval burden and query exposure. We present Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (PACS-FedRAG), an online selector that takes into account perturbed semantic profiles along with evidence feedback, latency, payload cost, and exploration. In a ten-client setting where three clients are chosen, the archived end-to-end benchmark reports an evidence overlap of 0.372 and an answer accuracy of 0.287. The retrieval-only evaluation, on the other hand, reuses a full-broadcast baseline with a different fusion tie-breaking policy. Rank fusion across disjoint client corpora imposes an overlap ceiling of 0.375, limiting its interpretation as a relevance measure. translated_title: 面向联邦检索增强生成的隐私感知自适应客户端选择
translated_abstract: 联邦检索增强生成需要从分布式语料库中检索证据。然而，向所有客户端广播查询会增加检索负担和查询暴露风险。我们提出了面向联邦检索增强生成的隐私感知自适应客户端选择（PACS-FedRAG），这是一种在线选择器，综合考虑了扰动语义画像、证据反馈、延迟、负载成本和探索机制。在从十个客户端中选择三个客户端的设置下，存档的端到端基准测试报告了0.372的证据重叠度和0.287的答案准确率。另一方面，仅检索评估复用了采用不同融合平局决胜策略的全广播基线。跨不相交客户端语料库的排名融合存在0.375的重叠上限，限制了其作为相关性度量的解释。答案准确率低于固定标签诊断基准的0.645，且原始生成器响应不可用（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出PACS-FedRAG，一种面向联邦检索增强生成的隐私感知自适应在线客户端选择方法，通过综合扰动语义画像、证据反馈、延迟和负载成本等因素选择性选取部分客户端处理查询，从而降低检索负担和查询暴露风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACS-FedRAG, a privacy-aware adaptive online client selection method for federated retrieval-augmented generation that leverages perturbed semantic profiles, evidence feedback, latency, and payload cost to selectively choose clients, thereby reducing retrieval burden and query exposure compared to broadcasting queries to all clients.
